themes.label: AI should serve, not hinder, humanity
themes.definition: Aspirational statement that AI should serve humanity rather than hinder it, embedded in a vision of freedom and non-oppression.
themes.inclusion: Passages expressing that AI should serve humanity, freedom or human dignity, even in brief aspirational form.
themes.exclusion: Passages that make concrete regulatory proposals or name specific AI harms.
themes.boundary_cases: A passage split mid-sentence ('serves rather than' / 'hinders humanity') counts when the clause about AI is visible in either part.

examples.quote: I want to live in a world where everybody can feel free, where artificial intelligence serves rather than
hinders humanity and where nobody has to fear oppression based on gender, race, nation, beliefs or one’s thoughts

value.rationale: Two consecutive fragments of Estonia's 2024 speech containing a brief aspirational clause that AI should serve rather than hinder humanity, within a broader vision of freedom.
